description: Instantly is a sales engagement and lead intelligence platform for outbound prospecting, campaign automation, deliverability management, and CRM workflows. It combines lead data, outreach tooling, inbox management, and AI-assisted sales operations in one product.
summary: Instantly exposes a REST API at `https://api.instantly.ai/api/v2`, a hosted MCP server at `https://mcp.instantly.ai/mcp`, and an `instantly` CLI; all use the same Instantly API v2 key for authentication.
